scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the complete stated Hilbert-space family; finite exact and numerical checks are supplementary only. No external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The frequency-mean measure is not a normalized operator trace.
No extension beyond Hilbert Hardy/Bergman or two nontrivial atoms.
The quantitative Hausdorff upper bound is not claimed sharp.
Independent validation and a complete historical publication-priority search remain outstanding.
title: Spectral topology and radial invisibility for two-scale atomic Hausdorff operators
